{{Top|leg}}
'''Sakira''' was the daughter of [[Bunker Aleph-One]]'s [[Control Aleph-One|controller]] on [[Revos Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. Her name was used as the code to recall the spaceport's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] back to base.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
